title: Senior Technical Lead – Industrial networking and motor control software
description:
Senior Technical Lead – Industrial Networking and Motor Control Software
   

  

**Senior Technical Lead – Industrial Networking and Motor Control Software**
**Pune / Bangalore – India**
*Join the RISC\-V Revolution!*
**About GlobalFoundries**
 GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
   

  

 Introduction
   

  

 We are looking for a senior technical leader to own industrial networking and motor control software for our next\-gen RISC\-V\-based real\-time MCUs. Industrial networking sits at the heart of our industrial strategy – where the hardest problems live: complex switch and protocol IP, tight real\-time latency budgets, and a wall of certification and conformance requirements. You’ll lead the software team building production\-grade Industrial Ethernet stacks (EtherCAT, PROFINET, CC\-Link IE TSN, Ethernet/IP), integrating them with motor control on the same MCU, and getting all of it validated on FPGA and first silicon.
   

  

**This Is a Chance To**
* Build the software that turns our industrial protocol IP into something a customer can actually ship.
* Work where networking, real\-time control, and functional safety meet – factory automation, robotics, motor drives, and zonal/edge compute.
* Shape a growing team and set the technical direction for a strategic, high\-visibility area of the business.


 Our aim is to build software components that not only let our IP and SoC solutions be thoroughly validated but also give customers and partners a robust repository of software to kick\-start their adoption of MIPS IP and SoCs – extracting the highest performance from hardware and software working together.
   

  

 If you’re an innovative problem solver with a deep passion for embedded networking and real\-time software, and you like building things from the ground up, we want to hear from you. As our mission goes, we are committed to offering “Freedom to Innovate Compute” – join us in accelerating your impact on the larger industry, and your own growth.
   

  

**Our Key Differentiators**
 Our RISC\-V MCUs are built with features that matter for this domain:
   

  

* Real\-Time Hardware Multithreading (RTMT): run the protocol firmware, TSN/time\-sync, and application on dedicated hardware threads with minimal context\-switching overhead – the key to hitting industrial latency targets.
* Integrated TSN Ethernet switch and industrial protocol IP: multi\-port TSN switch with the full 802\.1 feature set, plus paths to EtherCAT, PROFINET IRT, and CC\-Link IE TSN.
* Custom instructions for math\-intensive motor control, so networking and real\-time control can live on one chip.


**Key Responsibilities**
 Team Leadership
   

  

* Build and lead a 5\+ member cross\-functional embedded software team across industrial networking and motor control.
* Define execution plans, schedules, and quality metrics across SDK, protocol stacks, and validation.
* Mentor engineers; guide them through hard technical calls and delivery pressure.


 Industrial Networking Software
   

  

* Deliver and integrate Industrial Ethernet stacks – EtherCAT (master and SubDevice), PROFINET RT/IRT, Ethernet/IP, CC\-Link IE TSN, Modbus, and HSR/PRP redundancy – through in\-house work and partners (RT\-Labs, be.services, Beckhoff/Siemens IP).
* Own a stack abstraction (port layer) and common APIs so customers and third\-party stacks drop in cleanly.
* Contribute to and leverage the RISC\-V open\-source ecosystem


 Motor Control Software
   

  

* Guide real\-time control software (FOC loops, ADC/PWM handling, encoder interface) and its co\-existence with the networking stack on shared cores/threads.
* Deliver reference applications and customer packages that combine motor control with industrial connectivity.


 Certification, Conformance \& Compliance
   

  

* Own conformance and certification readiness – CLPA (CC\-Link IE TSN), EtherCAT Conformance Test Tool, PROFINET (ART Tester), and TSN profiles (IEC/IEEE 60802\).
* Set up conformance test infrastructure and drive the software to pass it.


 Post\-Silicon Validation (AVV) \& Bring\-Up
   

  

* Define and run the software\-centric validation strategy for the networking and control subsystems on FPGA and first silicon.
* Lead bring\-up, deep debugging, and regression of Ethernet/TSN switch, MACs, DMA, PHYs, timers, CAN/LIN.
* Build automation for lab validation and CI pipelines; support ASIL\-level safety validation where applicable.


 Cross\-Functional \& Customer Engagement
   

  

* Work closely with SoC/hardware, IP (e.g. Comcores/PacketArchitects), and safety teams; feed learnings back into next\-gen switch and CPU features.
* Engage OEM/Tier\-1 and industrial customers (factory automation, robotics, motor drives) on integration, onboarding, and SDK adoption.


**Ideally, You’ll Have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
* 7\+ years in embedded software and/or post\-silicon validation, with at least 2\+ years leading a team.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Industrial Ethernet and TSN – EtherCAT, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, CC\-Link IE TSN, or HSR/PRP – including the IEEE 802\.1 TSN standards. This is the core of the role; we want someone who has actually shipped and certified this, not read about it.
* Strong RTOS background (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), device drivers, and real\-time systems.
* Working knowledge of motor control fundamentals (FOC, ADC/PWM, encoders) or a demonstrated ability to lead across networking and control.
* Hands\-on bring\-up and debug with OpenOCD, Segger J\-Link, Lauterbach.
* Solid scripting and automation (Python, Bash) and familiarity with CI/CD.


**You Might Also Have**
* Experience taking an industrial protocol stack through conformance/certification (CLPA, EtherCAT CTT, PROFINET) a real plus.
* Prior delivery of networking or motor control SDKs to Tier\-1s or OEMs.
* Familiarity with LwIP, OpenAvnu, gPTP/1588 time\-sync stacks.
* Knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262 / IEC 61508\), bootloaders, secure boot, and firmware update.
* Familiarity with RISC\-V ISA; exposure to other ISAs (ARM64, x86\_64\).

The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development.  We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.
   

  

****Network Support Engineer****

**About This Role**

* Coordinate software upgrades and hardware modernisation initiatives to ensure network stability and vendor compliance
* Produce Internet exchange resilience reporting and performance metrics for regulatory and business stakeholders
* Design optimisation and customer migration solutions that support strategic network transformation and cost efficiencies
* Review capacity requirements across interconnect platforms including DIAoMSP NNI, SISA, and B2B connectivity environments
* Support annual bandwidth forecasting, business case preparation, and investment planning activities
* Conduct traffic analysis for peering and content delivery networks using tools such as Deepfield to optimise network performance and identify growth opportunities
* Support Internet cyber defence initiatives through traffic monitoring, analysis, and migration activities associated with network protection programmes
* Contribute to automation initiatives, workflow simplification, and operational efficiency improvements
* Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) activities for workflow and process enhancements
* Develop Power Apps and automation solutions for cost management, inventory management, and process optimisation

* Engineering or Science graduate with relevant telecommunications or network engineering experience
* 7\-8 years of experience in Global Internet Capacity Planning and Network Design
* Strong knowledge of Layer 3 networking technologies and Internet infrastructure
* Experience working with Juniper and Cisco routing platforms
* Understanding of transmission networks, DWDM, OTN, and data centre connectivity environments
* Knowledge of network change management processes and governance frameworks
* Experience with inventory and workflow management platforms such as Cramer, MORI, or similar systems
* Ability to interpret network requirements and develop practical, scalable design solutions
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving capability, and attention to detail
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills with experience collaborating across multinational teams
* Experience in Power BI development and data visualisation
* Experience developing solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate
* Knowledge of scripting and network automation technologies
* CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent networking certification is preferred
* OSS/BSS platform knowledge or relevant certifications, including Amdocs or Cramer, are advantageous

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to work on one of the world's largest global Internet networks supporting international connectivity and digital services
* Exposure to global stakeholders, multinational teams, and diverse network environments
* Involvement in strategic network transformation, optimisation, and resilience programmes
* Participation in emerging automation and digitalisation initiatives that improve operational efficiency
* Opportunity to influence network investment planning, capacity strategy, and technology lifecycle decisions

**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced Internet capacity planning and traffic engineering techniques
* Global\-scale network architecture and resilience planning
* Network lifecycle management and infrastructure modernisation strategies

* Advanced network analytics, dashboarding, and performance reporting using Power BI

**Join Us**

**Job Title**

 Manager \- Core Performance

 M1

 Technology
   

  

**Sub\-Function**
 Central Operations Group :Core Performance\-Active Operations
   

  

**Reports To**
 TL \- Data Core Performance
   

  

**Location Type:**
 Pune\-COR
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The TM – Core Performance role requires strong knowledge of 4G LTE/EPC and 5G NSA/SA architecture, along with hands\-on experience in Packet Core KPI monitoring, analysis, and troubleshooting. The role also requires a good understanding of core network elements, DNS, interfaces, protocols, Cloud/NFV infrastructure, and Cloud KPIs such as CPU, memory, disk, VM/container health, and network utilization. Key responsibilities include identifying KPI degradation, performing PCAP analysis, conducting troubleshooting and RCA, and coordinating with internal teams and vendors to maintain network performance and service stability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* PAN\-India Core Monitoring: Monitor performance across multi\-vendor core network nodes, including MME, SGW, PGW, and PCRF.
* Success Rate Tracking: Track key Packet Core success metrics, including S11 SR, ASR, PDN, LUSR, and WiFi\-to\-LTE handovers, and initiate timely corrective actions.
* Capacity and Throughput Management: Audit IP pool utilization and SGW/PGW throughput trends to support demand forecasting and capacity planning.
* Enterprise Platform Oversight: Monitor DRA/OCS performance and AAA/APN\-wise KPIs to support enterprise service efficiency and stability.
* P1 Incident Response: Support high\-priority incident resolution through real\-time KPI analysis, alerting, and coordination with cross\-functional teams.
* Reporting and Audits: Conduct parameter audits for quality compliance and publish weekly Data Core and Cloud KPI trend reports.
* Technology Evolution: Build knowledge across emerging technology areas, including WiFi, DNS, Cloud KPIs, and Packet Core 4G/5G architectures.
* Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor infrastructure\-level Cloud KPIs such as CPU load, virtualization latency, VM/container health, and virtual switch packet drops for cloud\-native telecom functions.
* OpenSignal, Customer Complaints and User Experience Monitoring: Monitor OpenSignal KPIs, including download/upload speed, latency, packet loss, discard rate, and TTFB. Analyse customer complaints and experience indicators, correlate them with network KPIs to drive service improvements and corrective actions.


**Technical/ Functional Competencies**
* Packet Core KPI Monitoring: Track performance across MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, and DNS elements.
* Enterprise Core Performance: Monitor DRA, OCS, PCRF, AAA, and APN performance indicators.
* Data Core Protocols: Understand S11, S5, and S8 interfaces, along with GTP, Diameter, and Radius protocols.
* Capacity Utilization Analysis: Analyse IP pool utilization, throughput trends, and demand projections.
* Network Performance Reporting and Alerting: Prepare KPI dashboards, configure threshold alerts, and support performance reporting.
* Cloud Infrastructure Performance: Understand RHOSP and RHOCP architectures and monitor key cloud performance indicators.
* User Experience KPI Correlation: Correlate OpenSignal, TTFB, latency, throughput, packet loss, and discard\-rate metrics with network performance.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking: Strong capability to dissect complex network data and troubleshoot underlying protocol issues.
* First\-Time\-Right Approach: High commitment to quality and accuracy in execution to minimize network downtime.
* Accountability \& Ownership: Demonstrated capability to own network issues from initial detection through to final resolution.
* Digital Mindset: Adaptable to evolving cloud\-native telecom technologies and automated monitoring systems.
* Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across cross\-functional engineering and infrastructure teams.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Minimum Education Qualification**
 B.E./B.Tech — Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science.
   

  

**Years Of Working Experience**
 Minimum 4–6 years of experience in core network performance management or Packet Core operations, with exposure to multi\-vendor 4G/VoLTE environments and a basic understanding of Cloud/NFV infrastructure.

title: Senior Support Specialist (Security & Network)
description:
*Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle.*
*The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry’s first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human\-in\-the\-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*
*Built cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve.*
*Securonix is recognized as a six\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always\-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience.*
*Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long\-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve.*
*With more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work.*
* We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability.
* We are customer driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes.
* We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast.


*That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations.*
**Role Summary**
 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
   

  

 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 Network Security Ownership
   

  

* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.


 Threat Detection \& Incident Response
   

  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.


 Security Operations Engineering
   

  

* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.


 Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation
   

  

* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.


 Risk, Governance \& Assurance
   

  

* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.


 Architecture \& Strategic Hardening
   

  

* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.


**Required Experience**
* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


**Preferred Experience**
* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.


**Benefits**
*As a full\-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:*
* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents\-in\-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**Job Description**
**Meet the Team**
 Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is a global team of extraordinary technical specialists whose singular focus is delivering a premier customer experience. We partner with the world's leading Service Providers to tackle their most complex network transformation challenges — designing, deploying, and optimizing next\-generation infrastructures built on Cisco's industry\-leading IOS\-XR platforms, IP/MPLS architectures, and cloud\-native solutions. Our SP Migration practice sits at the heart of some of the largest and most strategically significant network modernization program globally, driving measurable outcomes for customers while advancing Cisco's position as the trusted partner of choice.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Consulting Engineer (G4\) within the SP Migration practice, you will be an active contributor to the full lifecycle of large\-scale Service Provider network migration projects. Working alongside senior technical leads, you will help accelerate customer business outcomes by supporting the design, configuration, testing, and execution of migrations across Cisco SP platforms. This role offers hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge network technology, real\-world migration execution, and the opportunity to develop deep expertise in IOS\-XR, IP/MPLS, and automation — positioning you for accelerated career growth within Cisco CX.
   

  

* Support the design and implementation of Service Provider network migrations, including platform upgrades, topology changes, and protocol transitions across Cisco IOS\-XR \& Nexus \-based router platforms (ASR, NCS, and Cisco 8K Series).
* Contribute to the development of technical documentation including test plans, MOPs, and post\-migration validation reports that meet Cisco CX quality standards.
* Apply Python scripting and automation tooling to accelerate repetitive migration tasks, improving delivery efficiency and reducing manual error rates.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including TAC, and partner organizations to resolve escalated issues and maintain customer satisfaction throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Identify and escalate risks proactively, providing structured problem analysis and recommended mitigation actions to senior engineers and program leads.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent, demonstrable work experience in a network engineering role.
* Active CCNA certification; CCNP (Service Provider) certification highly desirable or actively in progress.
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco routing and switching platforms, including exposure to IOS\-XR environments.
* Working knowledge of core Service Provider networking protocols: BGP, IS\-IS, OSPF, IP/MPLS, and QoS fundamentals.
* Demonstrated experience supporting or executing network migration activities, including lab validation, MOP adherence, and change window participation.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with competitor SP platforms (Juniper, Nokia, Huawei or Arista) is desired.
* Basic proficiency in Python scripting for network automation tasks; exposure to Ansible, REST APIs, or NETCONF/YANG is an advantage.
* Foundational awareness of AI/ML applications in network operations (AIOps) and an interest in leveraging AI\-driven tooling to enhance service delivery.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical procedures clearly and engage confidently with customer technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented, high\-velocity delivery environment; proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous learning.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:
**Job Summary**
 Provides application or infrastructure technical expertise, analysis and specifications for IT systems to meet business requirements in accordance with IT architecture policies and standards; translate requirements into technical specifications, create detailed solution design, coordinate construction, installation, configuration and testing of IT systems; and identifies, troubleshoots and resolves system technical issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Assists in creating and managing the technical specifications from which programs and configurations will be applied to create the application, infrastructure or complete solution. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial\-of\-the\-shelf products versus custom built solution. Delivers solution design, adhering to standards and leveraging re\-use of components. Assists in creating high level and detail design of infrastructure OR applications, interfaces, conversions, extensions, reports, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards have been adhered to by the development team(s). Leverages re\-usability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solution Ensures adherence to obtain efficiency in the build and deploy processes, leveraging automation where possible. Assists in the test strategy and execution of master test plan. Participates in the creation of standards, processes, procedures, and guidelines for the IT design and development community as well work instructions or ‘runbooks’ used for end\-user support. Analyzes and revises existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements in the application or infrastructure solution. Provides level 3 support for critical issues.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Data Modeling \- Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Performance Tuning \- Conceptualizes, analyzes and solves application, database and hardware problems using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Configuration \- Configures, creates and tests a solution for commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) applications using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Design \- Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Functional Fit Analysis \- Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Modeling \- Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

 College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

-

title: Lead, Resiliency Engineer
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The
 **Lead, Resiliency Engineer** 
 will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our disaster recovery programs. Your strong technical background and infrastructure expertise will be critical in identifying potential risks and developing strategies to mitigate the impact of disasters. You will work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to ensure our business remains secure and resilient in the event of any unforeseen disruptions including cyber recovery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Disaster Recovery Planning: Develop and maintain comprehensive disaster recovery plans, including risk assessments, continuity strategies, and response procedures.
* Risk Assessment: Identify potential threats and vulnerabilities, conducting risk assessments to evaluate their impact on business operations.
* Disaster Recovery Testing: Plan, execute, and evaluate regular disaster recovery exercises to validate the effectiveness of recovery plans and make necessary adjustments.
* Coordination: Collaborate with IT, security, and other relevant departments to ensure alignment between disaster recovery and security strategies.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate documentation of disaster recovery plans, procedures, and incident response protocols.
* Incident Response: Lead disaster recovery efforts in the event of a disruption, coordinating the response and recovery activities.
* Training and Awareness: Develop and provide training to employees on disaster recovery and business continuity procedures to enhance preparedness.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on industry best practices, emerging technologies, and evolving threats to continually improve disaster recovery capabilities.


**On\-Premises \& Data Center Resilience**
* Oversee DR architecture for on\-premises data centers including storage replication (NetApp SnapMirror, Pure Storage ActiveCluster), SAN/NAS failover, and bare\-metal recovery.
* Manage relationships with colocation and secondary data center providers to ensure contractual alignment with DR objectives.
* Drive server virtualization recovery strategies using VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM) and Veeam.


**Cybersecurity \& Ransomware Recovery**
* Design and maintain immutable backup architectures and air\-gapped environments to protect against ransomware and destructive cyberattacks.
* Lead cyber recovery exercises simulating ransomware scenarios; document and refine clean\-room recovery playbooks.
* Collaborate with the CISO and SOC to integrate DR procedures into the Incident Response (IR) lifecycle, ensuring seamless handoffs from containment to recovery.
* Champion zero\-trust recovery principles, including identity verification during failover and integrity validation of recovered workloads.


**Compliance, Audit \& Governance**
* Maintain DR program alignment with ISO 22301, NIST SP 800\-34, SOC 2 Type II, and applicable industry regulations (HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, GDPR as relevant).
* Own all DR\-related evidence gathering, documentation, and remediation activities for internal and external audits.
* Report program health, test outcomes, and risk metrics to executive leadership and the Board on a regular cadence.
* Establish governance frameworks including DR policy, standards, and exception management processes.


**Testing, Drills \& Continuous Improvement**
* Plan and execute full\-scale DR tests (tabletop, functional, and full failover) across production\-equivalent environments at least twice per year.
* Track and drive closure of test findings; maintain a risk register for unresolved gaps.
* Implement chaos engineering principles and game\-day exercises to proactively uncover resilience weaknesses.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 6 years focused on Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or Site Reliability Engineering.
* Deep expertise designing and operating DR solutions on at least two major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including cross\-region replication, Route 53 / Traffic Manager / Cloud DNS failover, and managed database HA.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with on\-premises DR technologies: VMware SRM, Veeam, Zerto, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience building and executing ransomware recovery programs, including immutable storage and cyber recovery runbooks.
* Strong command of compliance frameworks: ISO 22301, NIST SP 800\-34 / CSF, SOC 2, and relevant sector regulations.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Proven track record leading enterprise\-wide DR exercises and driving RTO/RPO attainment at scale.
* Exceptional technical writing skills; able to produce executive\-ready reports and detailed runbooks with equal clarity.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
